findings: No code change in this pass (builder.output.md). The review is of the existing harness and the committed evidence in runs/eval/ (GitHub Actions run 42127124473) against S1-S5 and the requirements.

S1: runs/eval/RESULTS.md records health, catalog and MCP smoke checks as pass at upstream commit cdaf61e1bd0cf3820d11d72b43bb460816aebbd3, with evidence files under runs/eval/smoke/. The MCP probe is in process rather than over the network; the Limits section names it as an equivalent, as S5 requires.

S2: the fixture is present (fixture/generate.py, GROUND_TRUTH.md, checklist.json, questions.json, seed CSVs). It has 8 tables across Source A (Postgres) and Source B (DuckDB), with the four required planted conflicts in a machine-readable checklist.

S3: RESULTS.md reports all four conflicts marked, each with a verbatim catalog quote. Time to first ontology is 15.42 s with start and end timestamps. All four marks are 'ignored', with quotes that are only table-name lines such as 'name: fact_sales'. This is allowed by the spec and reported honestly, but it is thin evidence: the quotes show the table exists, not how the conflict was or was not handled.

S4: 12 questions were run on both arms with the same chat model and settings (temperature 0.0, max_tokens 8192), recorded in generation_settings.json. Results: Auto Ontology 0/12, raw schema 8/12, delta -8. Every Auto Ontology answer is 'no answer' and none has provenance. The failure gallery quotes wrong SQL verbatim for the raw-schema arm and states 'No SQL was produced' for the Auto Ontology arm. The result is unflattering to the tool but faithful to the executed run, and S4-DIAGNOSIS.md is present.

S5: RESULTS.md has every required section (environment, time to first ontology, checklist, per-question table, failure gallery, limits). Limits name both required equivalents: in-process MCP, and raw-schema SQL run on an SQLite copy. Claims stay within what the fixture exercised.

Requirements: the pins match Amendment 2 (chat model nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b, embed and rerank unchanged). A grep of runs/ and src/ found no NVIDIA API key; the only 'nvapi-' hits are comments in the source and the security review text. Steps run fail closed (steps.json shows all steps ok), and nothing is published.

Open item, not an implementation defect: the spec's coverage section says the product owner must record an amendment choosing between (a) accepting run 42127124473 as wo-gh-1 evidence and (b) rerunning into a new directory. No such amendment exists, and the builder correctly declined to guess. Recommend the owner records (a) or (b). This review passes on the basis that the existing evidence satisfies S1-S5.
